title: GTA 6 Made an Estimated $2.36 Billion in One Day 💰 #Shorts
description:
GTA 6 sold an estimated 24.5 million copies and made about $2.36 billion in less than 24 hours, according to Sensor Tower estimates reported by Reuters. GTA 5 made $815 million on its first day in 2013 (Guinness World Records). Around 75% of copies were on PlayStation. Take-Two has not released official sales figures yet.

Sources: Reuters ("Take-Two set to shatter sales records as 'GTA VI' launches to massive fanfare", 11/19/2026); Sensor Tower estimates via Deadline.
Images: official Rockstar Games trailers.

Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
